```yaml
name: E2E Kind PR

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  tdd-ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install playwright
          playwright install

      - name: Run UI tests
        run: ./91-run-ui-tests.sh

      - name: Upload test report
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: 'Playwright UI Tests'
          path: 'playwright-results/*.json'
          reporter: 'github-actions'

  tdd-kind:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install playwright
          playwright install

      - name: Start Kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@v1.14.0
        with:
          version: 'latest'
          cluster_name: 'kagenti-cluster'

      - name: Forward ports
        run: |
          kubectl port-forward svc/backend-service 8080:80 &
          kubectl port-forward svc/keycloak-service 8443:8443 &

      - name: Run UI tests
        run: ./91-run-ui-tests.sh

      - name: Upload test report
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: 'Playwright UI Tests'
          path: 'playwright-results/*.json'
          reporter: 'github-actions'

  tdd-hypershift:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install playwright
          playwright install

      - name: Start Hypershift cluster
        # This step would typically involve setting up a Hypershift cluster,
        # which is beyond the scope of this example.
        pass

      - name: Handle TLS and credentials
        # This step would typically involve handling TLS and retrieving credentials,
        # which is beyond the scope of this example.
        pass

      - name: Run UI tests
        run: ./91-run-ui-tests.sh

      - name: Upload test report
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: 'Playwright UI Tests'
          path: 'playwright-results/*.json'
          reporter: 'github-actions'
```

Each section includes environment-specific setup, test execution commands, and debugging tips. The workflow uses the `dorny/test-reporter@v1` action to upload test reports to the GitHub UI. Note that the actual implementation of starting Hypershift clusters and handling TLS/credentials is not included in this example and would need to be adapted based on your specific requirements.
